cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Fake the Expertise
cards.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the boiler. Don't interrupt while I set the heating interval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the kitchen timer. The boiler engineer's on the phone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then relay his question accurately, please. We don't want two people diagnosing different things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He asks what temperature you measured. I told him you haven't measured one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please stop supplying your own answers. Put him on speaker; I'll establish what he means by 'measured.'

reason: Expose the bogus expert through the timer, then make A correct B communication and question the real engineer terminology to prevent scrutiny.
